image_description: A flat-lay product shot of a carpenter's tool kit on a white background. The image displays two soft-sided carrying cases (one black, one light grey) and an assortment of tools spread out in front of them. Visible tools include a red-handled hammer, a yellow tape measure, a small level, screwdrivers, pliers, and various other hand tools. The arrangement is somewhat organized but lacks the rigid compartmentalization of a hard-shell box.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the yellow tape measure and the green packaging/tool labels is illegible scribbles, typical of AI generation failing to render crisp typography.
The head of the red hammer appears fused with the handle and lacks clear definition between the claw and the striking face. It looks melted rather than like distinct metal parts.
The texture of the grey bag is overly smooth and uniform, lacking the subtle wrinkles, stitching details, or fabric weave expected of a canvas tool bag.
The blue plastic items in the bottom right corner seem to merge into each other without clear boundaries or functional separation.
